text:
Mobile app development involves creating applications that run on smartphones and tablets. One of the first decisions is choosing between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built specifically for iOS or Android using their own languages, offering better performance and smoother access to device features. Cross-platform tools, like React Native or Flutter, allow developers to write code once and use it on both systems, saving time and money.

Responsive design is another crucial aspect, ensuring the app adapts to different screen sizes and orientations. Finally, once the app is polished, it goes through app stores like Google Play and the App Store, where it must meet strict guidelines before being published. Regular updates and performance checks are vital for keeping users satisfied.
